html:
SMTO-CTR-0004 — Too many files or context items were added to one request

GUID: 995a3d69-8af3-4822-b72d-64cd78d06cce
Slug: task-contract-context-manifest-limit
Domain: CTR · Subsystem: task-contract

What happened

  • One request can bring in at most 32 attached files or context items, and this one had more. SMTO didn't act on this version of your request.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Remove attached files or context items that the request doesn't really need, so that 32 or fewer remain. SMTO refuses a single request that brings in more than 32 items.
  2. If you need them all, split the work into several requests, each with 32 or fewer items, and say in each one what to do with its items. Splitting keeps every item in use without losing any part of what you asked for.
  3. Send the trimmed request as a new message, adding its items with Add context. Sending the same oversized request again would be refused the same way.

What success looks like

  • The new task shows Task contract generated and starts working with the files you attached.

If it still fails

  • If you see this with 32 or fewer items attached, select Copy error details and send them, with the number of items you added, to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Task Contract context-manifest capture received more than 32 explicit source references for one request and refused to build the manifest.

What this means

  • Context-manifest capture receives more than 32 source references. This failure does not authorize execution for the rejected contract revision. Earlier revisions may already have effects; their original receipts remain authoritative. Diagnostic rendering makes no compiler or integrity-model call.

Why this can happen

  • Context-manifest capture receives more than 32 source references.

How to diagnose it

  • Count exact source references after the caller's selection and preserve required source coverage when reducing them.

How to fix it

  • capture_context_manifest in src/agent_runtime/native/task_contract.py rejects more than 32 explicit refs (prompt attachments plus context IDs carried from the prior contract). Reduce the request's attachments and context references to 32 or fewer, or split the work into separate tasks without dropping requirements; conversation-level grants beyond the explicit refs are trimmed automatically and do not cause this error.
  • Select a bounded set of required context references or deliberately split the work without dropping requirements.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • At most 32 intended supported references form a complete bounded manifest.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • This failure does not authorize execution for the rejected contract revision. Earlier revisions may already have effects; their original receipts remain authoritative. Diagnostic rendering makes no compiler or integrity-model call.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
